events.title: Attack UKMTO #207 16 November 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. The Company Security Officer of a Tanker has reported the vessel being struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound. This resulted in a fire in the engine room. No casualties have been reported and all crew have been accounted for. Damage assessment and environmental impact unknown at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Suspicious Activity UKMTO #206 16 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 206-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 16 Nov 26 Incident Time: 0330UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 430NM east of Socotra, Yemen. The Master of a tanker has reported being approached by a possible mothership and skiff in position 1202N 06147E. Four armed persons were sighted onboard the skiff, with a ladder also visible. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #205 15 November 2026 UKMTO is aware of a report by Indian Shipping Authorities of an attack on a Tanker while transiting through the Arabian Gulf eastbound prior to entering the Strait of Hormuz. The crew are accounted for and safe. Damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

Attack UKMTO #204 11 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 204-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 11 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1800UTC UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 14NM northwest of Ra’s al Khaymah, UAE. A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the engine room. No casualties have been reported and all crew have been evacuated safely. Fire-fighting efforts are currently ongoing. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Suspicious Activity UKMTO #202 11 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 202-26. UPDATE 001 UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. UPDATE 001: UKMTO have now gained confirmation that the tanker was struck with an unknown projectile whilst transiting the Strait of Hormuz. All crew are reported safe and well. Due to this confirmation, this has been re-classified as an Attack. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #201 10 November 2026 UKMTO INCIDENT 201-26 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 19NM northeast of Lima, Oman. The Master of a Tanker reports being struck by an unknown projectile. The crew are safe and there is no environmental impact reported. Master will conduct damage assessment at first light. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #203 10 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 203-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 10 Nov 2026 Incident Time: TBC UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident in the Arabian Gulf. A tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile whilst travelling eastbound. Multiple casualties were sustained and have been taken ashore for medical assistance. All remaining crew are safe and accounted for. No damage assessment or environmental impact are available at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.
